$comment: Machine-readable mirror of references/approved-sources.md. Consumed by scripts/source_learning.py (approved_domains) so newly discovered domains can be quarantined instead of auto-trusted. Keep in sync with the reference doc.

sources.name: Basketball Bundesliga
sources.notes: Official easyCredit BBL site. The league renamed: `basketball-bundesliga.de` no longer serves this site (TLS SNI failure on both the bare and www host, while DNS still resolves) and `x.com/BBLofficial` is a 404 while the other four approved X accounts answer 200 — the current locators are `easycredit-bbl.de`, `x.com/easyCreditBBL` and `youtube.com/@basketballbundesliga`. Verified 2026-09-17 by `scripts/link_inventory.py` + `scripts/link_check.py`. The Facebook page is UNVERIFIED either way and deliberately left as it was: facebook.com answers HTTP 400 to every user agent this repo sends, for every handle including a known-good one, so a probe there cannot tell a dead page from a blocked one. Re-verified 2026-09-30: the schedule page `/saison/spielplaene_liga-pokalspiele/hauptrunde` answers 200 with ~285 KB of server-rendered markup but carries NO `application/ld+json` and NO microdata, and its server-rendered game list reads „Keine Spiele für diese Saison gefunden“ — the fixtures are fetched client-side from `api.basketball-bundesliga.de`, which answers 401 without the credential the site itself holds. `scripts/fixtures.py` therefore needs a rendered capture fed through `--input` before BBL contributes any fixture; a plain GET legitimately yields none. That requirement is now met by a different route: the league's OWN iCalendar feed on the very host the page calls, `https://api.basketball-bundesliga.de/calendar/ical/all-games`, answers HTTP 200 with 90,568 bytes and 321 VEVENTs to any caller, no credential — verified 2026-09-30. `api.basketball-bundesliga.de` is listed here as the approved host for it. Its `SUMMARY` lines glue the competition onto the first club name (`easyCredit BBL Spiel ALBA BERLIN vs NINERS Chemnitz`), measured across all 321 events: exactly two prefixes, `easyCredit BBL Spiel` (306) and `BBL Pokal Spiel` (15), all left-hand side; `DTSTART` is floating and the zone is declared once at calendar level as `X-WR-TIMEZONE:Europe/Berlin`. A trimmed verbatim capture is in `tests/fixtures/feeds/`.

sources.name: Basketball Champions League
sources.notes: Official BCL site. Free for selected games only — a BCL page, the @BasketballCL X/Twitter account and the Basketball Champions League Facebook page must ALWAYS be checked for the free-game marker. Some games are free, others are behind a broadcaster subscription; a page that does not state free access is REJECTED.

sources.name: BKT EuroCup
sources.notes: Official BKT EuroCup site. Evidence and sourceReference ONLY: in Germany EuroCup games are carried by paid or geo-restricted broadcasters, so this site can never be a directLink. Verified live 2026-10-05 (HTTP 429 to a datacenter IP, the documented runner-IP class; the host answers).

sources.name: 2. Basketball Bundesliga (ProA/ProB)
sources.notes: Official German second/third-tier league site. Streams are PAID: verified 2026-10-05 from the league's own pass page — 'Die Spiele der 2. Basketball Bundesliga ProA kostenpflichtig auf Sporteurope.TV' with Einzelspiel 5,99 EUR (pay-per-view), Teampass 109,99 EUR, All-Access-Pass 189,99 EUR. The league site is announcement/schedule evidence and NEVER a directLink; a ProA/ProB link with no explicit free marker fails Check 1.

sources.name: Damen Basketball Bundesliga (1. DBBL)
sources.notes: Official German women's top league site. PAID from season 2026/27: the DBBL announcement (verified 2026-10-05) states 2025/26 games ran free on the 'Dyn Basketball' YouTube channel, 'Ab der Saison 2026/27 ist die Ausstrahlung aller Frauenbundesliga-Spiele auf der Streaming-Plattform Dyn Sport geplant' — and no DBBL game is in the current month's Dyn Free Spiele list. League site is announcement evidence ONLY, never a directLink.

sources.name: Regionalliga (league organisations)
sources.notes: Official German fourth-tier league sites (RL Nord, RL Suedost). Schedules and standings ONLY — there is no centralised stream; Sporteurope.TV carries an RL Suedost section whose pricing is not readable without a rendering backend. A Regionalliga game is free only when the CLUB's own official channel carries a live/upcoming broadcast (Tier 6 rules apply); a league-site link is never a directLink. Verified 2026-10-05.

sources.name: Sportschau (ARD)
sources.notes: Free public broadcaster. Streams selected BBL top games free, announced days ahead (worked 2026-09-26: FC Bayern Muenchen vs ALBA BERLIN, 26.09.2026 ab 15:30 Uhr im Ersten) — a dedicated sportschau.de livestream page plus the same game in the ARD Mediathek. sportschau.de is the stored link.

sources.name: Dyn Sport Mix
sources.notes: Free tier only. amazon.de / primevideo.com require a Prime subscription -> reject. Free access is decided PER GAME from dyn.sport/deinsender/dyn-sport-mix/ ('Dyn Free Spiele' / 'Basketball Free Spiele', a month of games at a time): on the list -> Check 1 PASS, absent -> Check 1 FAIL even though Dyn broadcasts the very same game. dyn.sport is announcement evidence and the sourceReference, NEVER the directLink — its own player sits behind the paid Dyn service; the link must be joyn.de / pluto.tv / zattoo.com, and the indexed channel URL is the one that answers: zattoo.com/de/live-tv/sender/dyn-sport-mix and joyn.de/sender/dyn-sport-mix both returned 404 on 2026-09-26 while https://pluto.tv/gsa/live-tv/6866525c8a412a0e95c438b4 returned 200. Promoted from a quarantined discovery on 2026-09-26 (tier row + this entry + eval cases 37 accept / 38 reject).

sources.name: MagentaSport / MagentaTV
sources.notes: Free access is decided PER GAME. Since 2026-09-29 the free games are listed on magenta.tv/sport under 'KOSTENLOS & OHNE LOGIN: LIVE-EVENTS VON MAGENTA SPORT', which is in NO web-search index; a plain GET returns an 858-byte app shell, so the listing is only readable through a rendering backend. The listings are EuroLeague basketball - the page never writes the word 'basketball' and never lists the BBL, so the league is read from each entry and an absent string is not an absent game. magentasport.de and the social accounts are corroboration only: their silence is NOT evidence against free access. See references/magenta-tv.md.

sources.name: Tampa 2 Films (community amateur-sport channel)
sources.notes: Community channel (not a league or federation): Tom films local Berlin amateur sport as a free hobby project. Added 2026-10-10 at the operator's request. Verified live 2026-10-10: `youtube.com/@tampa2films` answers 200 (channel UCDH9pTsSYS2zJDd_Rr9xbWg) and its RSS feed lists amateur basketball — `TuS Neukölln vs. VIMODROM Baskets Jena | DBBL-POKAL`, `TuS Lichterfelde vs. BBC 90 Köpenick | BBV-Pokal Herren`, `Mitte Supersonics vs. TSV Sportuniversum | Landesliga` — alongside other local sport, so it is a source only for a game it actually carries live. Live-only, future-only: see references/youtube-live-search.md.

sources.name: European domestic leagues (evidence only)
sources.notes: Official top-division league sites, one per country (Spain acb.com, Italy legabasket.it, France lnb.fr, Adriatic aba-liga.com, Greece esake.gr, Tuerkiye bsl.org.tr, VTB vtb-league.com, Belgium/Netherlands bnxtleague.com, Austria basketball.at, Switzerland swiss.basketball, Poland plk.pl). Evidence and sourceReference for fixtures and announcements ONLY: their domestic streams are paid or geo-restricted in Germany, so they can NEVER be a directLink and a link with no free marker fails Check 1. Verified live 2026-10-05; several answer 403/connection-reset to datacenter IPs (lnb.fr, bsl.org.tr), the documented runner-IP class, so an unreachable host is a transport fact and not evidence against a game.
